purpose: Single-environment research phenotypic fingerprint; not official DUS or validated identity lookup
audit_acceptance: 95% Wilson lower bound for uniqueness >=0.95; no repeated search after audit failure
numeric_primary_error_model: joint empirical vector of signed relative variety-level image-minus-reference discrepancies; count uses absolute discrepancy
categorical_model: reference-state conditional confusion transitions; pooled-output prior strength1; Dirichlet probability uncertainty sampled once per simulated panel
categorical_dependence_primary: conditional independence across traits, given reference states
categorical_dependence_sensitivity: shared uniform random variates across categorical traits
source: Rebuilt S3 from frozen object/rater records: numerical means of20 paired objects; categorical modes of9 ratings/3 outputs; derived T28 ratio of component means
codebook: reference-only mean/population SD with z=-0.8416,-0.2533,0.2533,0.8416; equality enters higher bin; count means nearest integer ties-to-even
tie_order: largest worst-source minimum type-matched code distance
confirmation_acceptance: All baseline-dual-unique subsets considered; 95% Wilson lower bound >=0.95 before size/rank selection; independent selected-subset audit follows
protocol_scope: Revision protocol specified before the revised subset searches and nested evaluations; not a prospective field-trial registration.
generalization_limit: Single-site/year panel; paired reference-image discrepancy simulation; fixed upstream image model; no external validation or reliable identity-matching claim.
membership: Supply the frozen 1000 reference/evaluation allocations as a private input to reproduce the reported runs.
input_format: Private variety_summary.csv and materials.csv; see data_schema/ and scripts/build_variety_table.py
